result.quote: “It is the man of God who disobeyed the command of the LORD. Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, and it has mauled him and killed him
result.reason: The key is explicitly supported, but the question is too broad to make it unique. The prophet also said that this was the man of God, that the LORD delivered him to the lion, and that the lion mauled and killed him. The edit also changes the prepared question’s scope from explaining the death—including the LORD’s delivering him to the lion—to asking generally what was said and giving only the disobedience detail.
